get_field_type: get a FieldType instance for a Python type like int, float, str, bool, bytes, numpy.ndarray, Enum, List, Dict, or dataclass
get_packed_value: pack a Python value into bytes using a FieldType for serialization with struct or pickle
get_unpacked_value: unpack bytes back into a Python value using a FieldType with struct or pickle deserialization
get_len_bytes: encode the length of an object as a zero-padded 10-byte ASCII length prefix
get_next_bytes: read a length-prefixed chunk of bytes from a byte stream and return the raw bytes and updated cursor position
